findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when the user has no TopicUser record
findings.body: TopicUser.find_by can return nil, but lines 107-113 immediately call tu.notification_level and tu.save!. A user can receive a topic notification without a TopicUser row (for example via a watched category for a newly created topic, before ever visiting it), and a user who was emailed via mailing-list mode may also not have visited. Clicking the email unsubscribe link for such a topic then raises NoMethodError (500) instead of creating a muted/regular record (e.g. via TopicUser.change, which creates the row when missing) and showing the unsubscribe page.

findings.title: State-changing unsubscribe is performed on an unauthenticated-token GET and is not idempotent
findings.body: The unsubscribe action mutates notification_level on a plain GET (routed in config/routes.rb, with check_xhr skipped and only cookie login required). Any link prefetcher, email security scanner (e.g. SafeLinks), or cross-site /link loaded in a logged-in browser will trigger it without user intent or a CSRF token. It is also not idempotent: watching/tracking (>regular) is demoted only to regular, so merely reloading/refreshing the unsubscribe page demotes regular to muted, silently changing the setting again on a safe-method request. The mutation should require a confirmation/POST (or a signed unsubscribe token) and set a single terminal level.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link translation now hard-requires unsubscribe_url for every add_unsubscribe_link email
findings.body: config/locales/server.en.yml changes unsubscribe_link to interpolate %{unsubscribe_url}, and both body (line 90) and html_part (line 67) render it whenever opts[:add_unsubscribe_link] is true. Only UserNotifications#send_notification_email was updated to pass unsubscribe_url; any other current/plugin/future caller that sets add_unsubscribe_link: true without unsubscribe_url will now raise I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument and fail to send mail instead of rendering the previous preferences-only footer. MessageBuilder should supply a default/empty unsubscribe_url or only append the per-topic sentence when a URL is present.

findings.title: No test covers the new unsubscribe endpoint or asserts the per-topic URL in email output
findings.body: The only spec change adds unsubscribe_url: "/t/1234/unsubscribe" to an existing builder fixture but adds no expectation that the URL appears in the text body or HTML part, and there are no controller specs for TopicsController#unsubscribe at all (existing-user demotion, already-regular/muted user, user with no TopicUser row, wrong slug redirect, JSON vs HTML). The nil-TopicUser crash and the level-transition behavior introduced by this feature can therefore regress or already be broken without any failing test.
